units.source_text: 比起我来，K是个有着坚强意志的人，学习也比我更努力，而且天分也比我高得多。

en.t: Compared with me, K was a man of strong will; he studied harder than I did, and his natural gifts were far greater than mine.

units.source_text: 后来，上大学由于专业不同不好说，但无论是初中还是高中，在一个班里学习的时候，K常常在我之上。

en.t: Later, at university, it was hard to compare us because our fields were different, but when we studied in the same class in middle school and high school, K was usually above me.

units.source_text: 所以，我一向都清楚自己不管干什么都不如他。

en.t: So I had always been clearly aware that, whatever I did, I was no match for him.

units.source_text: 但是，当我硬把他拉到我的住处来时，却自信我比他更明事理。

en.t: But when I forced him to come and live at my place, I was confident that I understood things better than he did.

units.source_text: 我认为，他并不理解克制和忍耐的区别。

en.t: I thought that he did not understand the difference between self-restraint and endurance.

units.source_text: 这是特意为你补写的，请你留心一下。

en.t: I am adding this especially for you, so please pay attention to it.

units.source_text: 无论是肉体上还是精神上，我们的一切能力都会因外部条件的刺激而提高或受到破坏。

en.t: Whether physical or mental, all our abilities can be improved or damaged by stimulation from external conditions.

units.source_text: 当然，无论提高还是破坏，都必须逐渐加强刺激，所以，如果不仔细思考的话，

en.t: Of course, whether the result is improvement or damage, the stimulation must be strengthened gradually; therefore, if one does not think carefully,

units.source_text: 便会朝着非常危险的方向滑下去，而没有人——更不用说自己了——能够察觉得到。

en.t: one may slide in a very dangerous direction without anyone, least of all oneself, being able to notice it.

units.source_text: 听医生说，人的胃是最懒惰的，如果光喝粥，便会不知不觉失去消化比粥更硬的东西的能力。

en.t: According to the doctor, the human stomach is the laziest thing of all; if one drinks only porridge, one will gradually lose the ability to digest anything harder than porridge without even realizing it.

units.source_text: 因此，医生嘱咐，尽量什么都吃。

en.t: For that reason, the doctor advised me to eat as many different things as possible.

units.source_text: 但是，我想医生的意思并不仅仅是指习惯吧，

en.t: But I think the doctor did not mean merely a matter of habit,

units.source_text: 很可能还有随着逐渐加强刺激，营养机能的抵抗力也会慢慢加强的含意。

en.t: he probably also meant that, as the stimulation is gradually strengthened, the resistance of the nutritive functions will slowly grow stronger too.

units.source_text: 相反，如果胃的消化能力逐渐衰弱，后果会如何不难想象。

en.t: Conversely, if the stomach's digestive power gradually weakens, it is not hard to imagine what the result will be.

units.source_text: K虽然是个比我有前途的人，却丝毫没有觉悟到这一层。

en.t: Although K was a man with more promise than I had, he had not realized this point in the slightest.

units.source_text: 他似乎认定，只要习惯了困难，最终就不觉得困难了。

en.t: He seemed convinced that as long as one became used to hardship, in the end it would no longer feel like hardship.

units.source_text: 他似乎坚信一点：只要反复经受磨炼，那么凭借这一功德，就会迎来不惧怕任何艰难困苦的那一天。

en.t: He seemed firmly to believe that if one repeatedly underwent discipline and hardship, then by virtue of that merit alone, the day would come when one feared no suffering or difficulty.
